subject.title: Guard Skill Workshop update applies against delta drafts

question: Should every Skill Workshop update-apply caller fail closed when the replacement body matches these proposal-note heuristics?
rationale: The guard prevents destructive overwrites, but its content heuristics intentionally trade compatibility for safety across CLI, Gateway, and agent-tool callers; code inspection cannot decide that product tolerance.

options.title: Accept the shared guard
options.body: Approve the conservative service-wide rejection policy and land the patch after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Narrow the rejection policy
options.body: Require a more structural or explicit proposal-format signal before rejecting updates, reducing false positives at the cost of weaker protection.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared guard
recommendation.body: Approve the conservative service-wide rejection policy and land the patch after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Their feature-history connection to the Skill Workshop lifecycle makes them the best available owner for this compatibility choice.
